label: Dry brush

reference.role: Identity and emotion reference; path geometry not locked.

direction: Painted gestures with dry edges, tapered flicks, bristle channels, uneven swept loops and negative-space skips within strokes.

review.method: Visual inspection of complete generated sheet against original reference.
changes: Eye loops are asymmetric and swept rather than circular arcs.
Tapered brush ends and bristle splits remain visible at thumbnail size.
Listening and sleepy mouths are hollow brush ovals rather than filled shapes.
Smirk, frown and closed eye arcs have directional painted construction.

faces.name: Calm
faces.notes: Open swept loops and a level flat brush mouth.

faces.name: Listening
faces.notes: Attentive loops with hollow vertical oval mouth.

faces.name: Curious
faces.notes: Asymmetric rounded triangular loops, small resting dot mouth.

faces.name: Quiet thought
faces.notes: Narrow half-closed brush forms with tiny mouth.

faces.name: Happy
faces.notes: Open loops and painted bowl grin; dry central gap is intentional brush construction.

faces.name: Playful
faces.notes: Half-closed brush eyes and rising smirk.

faces.name: Sleepy
faces.notes: Closed arcs and tall hollow oval yawn.

faces.name: Sad
faces.notes: Drooping irregular loops, clear frown and one outer-right tear.

limitations: Static style proposal, not an animation frame atlas.
Fine bristle channels may become less distinct at very small display sizes.
Brush geometry varies intentionally between expressions; production animation would require consistent component redraws.
